description: Rank counties by the projected change in expected deaths 2025-2040, for comparing service areas. National percentile computed across all 3,144 counties. A projection, not a recorded count; it says nothing about any individual or any provider. The tool NAME is kept as deathcare_growth_ranking so an existing key holder's calls keep working - read it as 'projected change'. PAID (Professional and above).
name: deathcare_growth_ranking
